description: Documented exceptions to the Subresource Integrity (SRI) check run by scripts/check-sri.js and enforced in CI. Every external (non-same-origin) script or stylesheet must either carry an `integrity` attribute or have a reviewed entry here explaining why it cannot.

exceptions.reason: Google Fonts negotiates the stylesheet body by User-Agent (different browsers get different @font-face rules), so the response body is not stable and a static SRI hash would break font loading for a subset of browsers.
Font binary URLs are only known after the negotiated stylesheet above is fetched, so they cannot be pinned ahead of time in index.html.

Analytics script (src/hooks/useAnalytics.ts) is injected only when a self-hosted analytics provider + id is configured via env vars, and the vendor rebuilds this file on their own release cadence, so a pinned hash would break tracking on every vendor deploy without our involvement. Loaded with defer and no DOM access before React mounts.

Placeholder self-hosted Umami analytics endpoint (src/hooks/useAnalytics.ts); same rationale as plausible.io above. Replace host with the real deployment and re-review when analytics is actually enabled.
